SEDATION DENTISTRY
IN KANSAS CITY

SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION

RELAXED, ANXIETY-FREE DENTAL CARE

Do you experience dental anxiety or have heightened sensitivity that makes dental visits uncomfortable? You're not alone. At Cosmetic & Implant Dentistry Westport, we understand that visiting the dentist can be stressful for many patients. That's why we offer sedation dentistry services to help you feel calm, comfortable, and relaxed during your dental procedures.

Our sedation dentistry options allow patients with high anxiety or sensitivity to receive the dental care they need without fear or discomfort. Whether you need a routine cleaning or a more complex procedure, we can help make your experience as pleasant as possible.

BOOK AN APPOINTMENT
Meet Your Sedation Specialist

DR. SHALEY BAKER

Sedation Certified Dentist — Missouri Sedation Certification

Dr. Shaley Baker is the primary dentist at ECare and holds her Sedation Certification for Missouri. She brings her expertise in sedation dentistry to our Westport location approximately 1-2 days a month, providing specialized care for patients who need a more relaxed dental experience.

With her gentle approach and extensive training in sedation techniques, Dr. Baker ensures that even the most anxious patients can receive the dental care they deserve. Her focus is on creating a calm, supportive environment where patients feel safe and at ease throughout their entire visit.

SCHEDULE YOUR CONSULTATION

BENEFITS OF SEDATION DENTISTRY

Sedation dentistry offers numerous advantages for patients who struggle with dental anxiety, fear, or sensitivity. Here's how it can transform your dental experience:

Reduced Anxiety

Feel calm and relaxed throughout your entire dental procedure, eliminating the stress and fear that often accompanies dental visits.

Time Efficiency

Multiple procedures can often be completed in a single visit while you're comfortably sedated, reducing the number of appointments needed.

Pain-Free Experience

Sedation helps manage heightened sensitivity and discomfort, ensuring you feel little to no pain during your treatment.

Better Dental Health

Patients who previously avoided the dentist due to fear can now receive regular care, leading to improved overall oral health.

Is sedation right for you?

WHO CAN BENEFIT FROM SEDATION DENTISTRY

Sedation dentistry is an excellent option for patients who experience:

  • High dental anxiety or fear of dental procedures
  • Heightened sensitivity to pain or discomfort
  • Difficulty getting numb with local anesthesia alone
  • Strong gag reflex that interferes with treatment
  • Need for extensive dental work in fewer visits
  • Past traumatic dental experiences
  • Difficulty sitting still for extended periods
  • Fear of needles or dental instruments
ASK ABOUT SEDATION

TYPES OF SEDATION WE OFFER

01

Nitrous Oxide (Laughing Gas)

Nitrous oxide is a mild sedative inhaled through a mask that helps you relax during your procedure. It takes effect quickly and wears off fast, allowing you to drive yourself home after your appointment. This is an excellent option for patients with mild to moderate anxiety.

02

Oral Sedation

Oral sedation involves taking a prescribed medication before your appointment to help you feel deeply relaxed. While you'll remain conscious and able to respond to instructions, you may feel drowsy and have little memory of the procedure afterward. You'll need someone to drive you to and from your appointment.

03

IV Sedation

For patients with severe anxiety or those undergoing extensive procedures, IV sedation delivers medication directly into the bloodstream for a deeper level of relaxation. You'll be in a sleep-like state but can still respond to verbal cues. This option provides the highest level of sedation while keeping you safe and comfortable.

SCHEDULE YOUR SEDATION
CONSULTATION TODAY

Take the first step toward comfortable, anxiety-free dental care. Contact us to learn more about our sedation options.

CALL 816-388-0985

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Is sedation dentistry safe?

Yes, sedation dentistry is very safe when administered by trained professionals like Dr. Baker. She holds her Missouri Sedation Certification and carefully monitors patients throughout every procedure. Before recommending sedation, we review your complete medical history to ensure it's the right option for you.

Will I be unconscious during the procedure?

With most sedation options, you'll remain conscious but deeply relaxed. You may feel drowsy and have limited memory of the procedure, but you'll be able to respond to instructions from Dr. Baker. Only general anesthesia results in complete unconsciousness, which is rarely needed for routine dental work.

How do I know which sedation option is right for me?

During your consultation, Dr. Baker will discuss your anxiety levels, medical history, and the procedures you need. Based on this information, she'll recommend the most appropriate sedation option. Whether you need mild relaxation or deeper sedation, we'll customize your care to meet your specific needs.

How often is sedation dentistry available at your office?

Dr. Shaley Baker provides sedation dentistry services at our Westport location approximately 1-2 days per month. We recommend scheduling your appointment in advance to secure a time that works for you. Contact our office to find out upcoming availability.
